description: List research resources associated with an ORCID researcher — compute allocations, equipment access, lab facilities, data resources, and clinical study registrations. This is a newer ORCID section; most researchers have no entries. Returns the resource title, hosting organization, external identifiers (often a URI to the allocation portal), access period, and the source that added each entry. Most entries are deposited by resource-allocation systems (e.g. ACCESS, XSEDE) rather than researchers themselves.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

name: orcid_get_research_resources

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Note when no research resources are found — this section is sparsely populated across ORCID profiles.

resourceCount.description: Total number of research resources returned.

resources.description: Research resources associated with this ORCID iD.

endDate.description: Access or allocation end date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

externalIds.description: External identifiers for the resource (often a portal URI).

items.description: External identifier for the research resource.

relationship.description: Relationship to the resource (self or part-of).

url.description: Resolver URL for this identifier, if available.

hostOrganization.description: Organization that hosts or manages the resource.

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated organization ID (e.g. ROR or GRID identifier).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of the disambiguation ID (e.g. ROR, GRID, RINGGOLD).

putCode.description: Put-code of this research resource record.

sources.description: The party that added this resource to the ORCID record — usually the allocation system that granted it. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the requested ORCID iD; false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

startDate.description: Access or allocation start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

url.description: URL for the resource or allocation record.

title: Get ORCID Research Resources
